notes.title: Game Update
notes.notes:
This update is all about “Delivery Must Go On – Clear All Obstacles!” making each delivery smoother than ever.

– Feature Adjustments –
Bat: Changed to a cooldown system, with increased attack range.
Dash: Now a short-range instant burst, knocking away all obstacles in the path.
Energy Drink: Fully restores stamina upon use—stamina will no longer hold you back.

– New Content –
Speed Boost Pads: Step on one to gain the “Power of Delivery,” boosting speed and granting temporary invincibility.
Delivery Combo: Each successful delivery gradually increases movement speed for that delivery.
Skip Delivery: In Relax Mode, you can now choose to skip the delivery process entirely.

notes.title: Delivery Hot Version Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45187047/615a67b5a4b7095f0bc93903c8862d2a2eb4b0b5.png[/img]
Thank you to all our players for your enthusiastic feedback! We have received every single comment.
Below are the new features and fixes we have implemented to improve the game experience and address bugs:

[list]
[*] Added a Super star item in the mobile relaxation mode.
[*] Removed bicycle-restricted zones.
[*] Fixed an issue where ejaculation animations in cross-section view displayed incorrectly.
[*] Removed a bug where Shiba Inu hit by a car would collide with the player.
[/list]
If you have any additional feedback, feel free to leave a comment below.
Thank you for your support! We hope 02 Studio can continue to bring you an even better gaming experience!
